description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing Project entities, providing CRUD operations secured with role-based access control. It exposes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting projects via Spring MVC annotations and integrates with a ProjectRepository for persistence.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: REST controller providing CRUD endpoints for Project entities with security annotations, using Spring Boot and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all projects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a project by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project, restricted to ADMIN role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project by ID, restricted to ADMIN role.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project by ID, restricted to ADMIN role.
